bugs: BUGS: 'does not exists' grammar in activate_user.py:32 and reset_password.py:39 — PORT verbatim.

BUGS (role default): create_project_member role = options.get('role', 20) (:37) — argparse sets options['role']=None when --role is absent, so .get's default NEVER fires and role is None (printed as 'Role: None', written as NULL). The 20 default applies only if the key were missing entirely. PORT: absent flag -> None.

BUGS (stderr-vs-CommandError split): reset_password email/user errors use self.stderr.write + return (exit 0), but the weak-password error raises CommandError (stderr 'Error: ...', exit 1). create_project_member catches ALL CommandErrors itself (:70-72) printing to STDOUT with exit 0. PORT each channel/exit exactly.

Quirk: create_instance_admin duplicate-admin path prints the inner message to STDOUT via print(e) (:42) then raises CommandError('Failed to create the instance admin.') -> stderr 'Error: Failed...' exit 1. PORT both lines.
